scenario_description:
Objective: Use a narrow library accessibility-lab opening to add practical shortcut setup before a planned report-writing block.
Emerging Need: A broad drop-in notice becomes a specific card only after the writing block, phrase-list notebook, small refundable deposit, and adjacent station time align.
Decision Context: Saved accessibility guidance distinguishes the text-expander station from generic tool browsing and identifies a de-identified phrase list as the useful preparation item; calendar, household message, wallet, and lab emails establish fit and timing.
Consequence: Timely organization could improve the upcoming documentation session without changing it; ignoring the opening leaves ordinary report writing unchanged, and after release the optional benefit is gone.

parameter.title: Central Library progress-report writing block
parameter.description: Hold for batch drafting speech progress reports after school; study-room confirmation pending.

parameter.subject: Next Friday drop-in stations during documentation tools week
parameter.body: Documentation tools week will include rotating drop-in stations next Friday from 2:00 to 4:30 p.m. Topics may include screen settings, stylus grips, and text-expansion basics. Any cancellation cards for staffed stations will be posted closer to the date; some may require a small refundable materials deposit.

parameter.content: Found the green phrase-list notebook under the mail. I left it on the entryway shelf beside your school badge, so it is not mixed in with my tote.

parameter.description: Small reimbursement cash set aside for refundable library deposits

parameter.subject: Cancellation card: district-safe text-expander setup, Nov. 6
parameter.body: One staffed cancellation card has opened for Friday, November 6, 2:50-3:20 p.m., immediately before the 3:30 study-room block. The station covers district-safe text-expander setup using only de-identified practice text. The card carries a $10 refundable materials deposit and must be claimed by 6:00 p.m. today; unclaimed cards release to the general waitlist.

parameter.subject: Text-expander cancellation card released
parameter.body: The Friday 2:50 p.m. district-safe text-expander cancellation card was not claimed by the 6:00 p.m. cutoff and has been released to the general waitlist. No additional staffed text-expander openings remain for November 6.
